payload.title: Run app policy hooks for sync-socket object upserts
payload.description: Post-merge Aura authorization review found FrameKind.ObjectUpsert used only the baseline decision and bypassed BootSeams policy hooks, even though normal TypeScript/Swift/Android SDK object writes use this gateway path. Apply the same baseline -> hooks -> write-grant relaxation pipeline as HTTP object writes and prove denial plus grant relaxation at the real frame handler.
